svg.text: New word-choice test set: Zhiyi ng1017+ML-pumpkin-1026 and earlier models
first candidate right %, 2183, higher is better
first candidate right %, 746, higher is better
first candidate right %, 724, higher is better
first candidate right %, 139, higher is better
first candidate right %, 304, higher is better
ms, median, 4 threads, lower is better
Test set: text from SkyPile, LCCC, Chinese and English C4, SODA and Tatoeba with its preceding text, typed in full pinyin,
initials, mixed, or the first letters of a word; the candidates are the IME engine's own. Every third row (4175; scored where
the right word is among two or more candidates). End to end in the IME engine (after the pause), the model on the graphics card
(DirectML); in English word mode the typed text stays first, so the first word after it. Original Laya = convaiinnovations/laya
on Hugging Face (based on mmBERT-base, not fine-tuned by Zhiyi) ranking the candidates the IME's way.
ng1017 = a word n-gram (Youmo IME's pinyin language model with science text mixed in, pruned to 79 MB); the composition
head's sentences also go through the word choice. ng1017+1.4V2-Long-L12 = a 12-layer model (word choice and composition
head distilled from fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B teachers) with ng1017; the default in 1.5.12-1.5.18.
ng1017+ML-pumpkin-1026 = Long-L12 trained further with Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Vietnamese
(only Simplified Chinese and English here), the default from 1.6.0. ng1017+ML-Flash-1031 = pumpkin cut to 8 layers with one
head for both tasks and a prefix mask: the context's keys and values are computed once per context (about 3.4 ms), a key only
runs the candidates and the typed units, and its CPU time is that of a key (pumpkin's whole graph 10.4 ms in the same loop);
not in the IME yet. ng1017+ML-Flash-1103 / ML-pumpkin-1103 = Flash (8 layers) and pumpkin's 12-layer prefix-mask, one-head
version, trained one more epoch over all the data (now with rows without context); CPU time also a key's with the context cached.
ng1017+zh-lite-preview = a small model that picks Simplified and Traditional Chinese candidates only (8 layers of width 256,
a compact input sequence), run in an engine that builds that sequence; it has no composition head, so long input gets the
engine's own sentences and scores lower; no English candidates. Its CPU time is scaled from ML-Flash-1103's in the same loop
(a key with the context cached); not in the IME yet.
Every row with the composition head
was re-run in the 1.6.0 engine, where the head's own sentences can come first (most of the gain is on long input whose last
syllable is typed only partly); the numbers in the text are from the engine of each release.
Speed: ONNX Runtime 1.24.4, int8, the same 274 pages, Ryzen 5 9600X; the new engine's extra composition runs in the
background and is not in the page time.
